reference.title: Toward an internally consistent pressure scale
reference.source: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences

methods.source_location: Article experimental XRD methods: Au powder pressure marker and Fei et al. (2007) EOS.

recalculation.notes: The official article and deposit provide reduced pressures but no row-wise Au lattice parameters or volumes, so the pressure reduction cannot be repeated observation by observation.

assessment.basis: Every compared free coefficient meets both the recorded combined-two-sigma comparison and parameter-specific numerical similarity screen. Error conventions and fit qualifications remain applicable.

fit.solver_message: Both `ftol` and `xtol` termination conditions are satisfied.

scientific_validation.note: Validated against the publisher article and the article's official Zenodo v2 raw-data deposit.

locations: publisher article experimental methods, EOS discussion, Figure 3, and data-availability statement
official Zenodo v2 files latticeparameters.xlsx, EoS-Ffplot-bulkv.xlsx, EPMA.xlsx, and DFTEoS.xlsx
primary_source_check.finding: The source defines three reproducible experimental BM2 fits: the preferred 23-row sample-1 curve, an 11-row after-current-step-anneal sample-1 comparison, and a 21-row cold-compressed sample-2 comparison. Spectroscopy demonstrates gradual Fe-Al exchange and a mixed-spin population, not a separately fitted fully low-spin branch.

primary_data_check.finding: All 44 official XRD rows are bundled with P, a, b, c, V, reported uncertainties, grain identity, thermal history, and explicit fit-selection flags.

independent_refit.objective: unweighted least squares in pressure residuals using the standard BM2 pressure equation
independent_refit.notes: The independent refit rounds to published V0=172.1 and lies within published K0=229+/-4 GPa. The source does not identify its numerical objective, weighting, software, covariance, or fit statistic, so this diagnostic is not asserted to reconstruct the authors' exact optimization protocol.

unresolved_issues: No parameter covariance, confidence convention, fit objective, weighting rule, software, or published fit statistic is reported.
The two analyzed synthesis compositions are not mapped to the individual XRD grains.
No row-wise Au observations are published for pressure-scale recalculation.

The DFT workbook contains complete energy-volume values and a reported fit, but the source states only energy-volume fitting and does not identify the exact energy equation/order; no executable DFT EOS is inferred.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: publisher article experimental methods, EOS discussion, Figure 3, and data-availability statement; official Zenodo v2 files latticeparameters.xlsx, EoS-Ffplot-bulkv.xlsx, EPMA.xlsx, and DFTEoS.xlsx.
parameter_provenance.equation: Article EOS section and Figure 3: standard second-order Birch-Murnaghan pressure-volume equation, equivalent to fixing K0'=4.
parameter_provenance.V0: Article EOS discussion: V0=172.1(4) angstrom^3 for sample 1 using all before- and after-current-step-anneal observations.
parameter_provenance.K0: Article EOS discussion: K0=229(4) GPa for sample 1 using all before- and after-current-step-anneal observations.
parameter_provenance.implicit_K0_prime: Second-order Birch-Murnaghan definition fixes K0'=4; it is not an independently fitted or stored BM2 parameter.
parameter_provenance.fit_selection: All 23 rows on the official Zenodo latticeparameters.xlsx 'sample 1' worksheet. Black-font rows are before current-step heating and red-font rows are after current-step heating.
parameter_provenance.uncertainties: Parenthetical published parameter uncertainties are retained, but the article does not state their confidence convention or covariance.

superseded_record_text.notes: Authors' preferred room-temperature BM2, chosen for denser coverage and because stepwise laser annealing promotes the thermodynamically stable cation ordering. This mixed-spin curve is the equilibrium default, but not a pure low-spin branch.
validity_notes: Bounds are the 23-observation fitted envelope, not a broader phase-stability field.
V0 is extrapolated because FA50 bridgmanite is not retained at ambient pressure.
The curve averages before- and after-current-step-anneal states and must not be interpreted as a pure low-spin branch.

methods.source_location: Article high-pressure methods: Ne pressure medium and pressure determination above 6 GPa.

recalculation.notes: Supplementary Table S3 reports reduced pressures but no row-wise Ne volumes, so the pressure scale cannot be independently recalculated.

scientific_validation.note: Validated against the open-access publisher article and its official Supplementary Table S3.

locations: publisher article Materials and methods and Figure 4 caption
primary_source_check.finding: The source reports a phase-specific Pnma BM2 and complete single-crystal unit-cell measurements. The two lowest-pressure Pnma refinements occur within the stated transformation interval; selecting the 16 observations above that interval reproduces the published coefficients and uncertainties.

primary_data_check.finding: All 18 Pnma Supplementary Table S3 rows are bundled with pressure, lattice parameters, conventional-cell volume, reported uncertainties, and explicit fit flags; 16 rows are selected.

independent_refit.objective: errors in variables using reported pressure and volume uncertainties
independent_refit.notes: The errors-in-variables coefficients agree with the published values within their quoted uncertainties. An unweighted pressure-space diagnostic gives V0=171.3058481114 angstrom^3 and K0=220.0209751528 GPa.

unresolved_issues: No parameter covariance, confidence convention, numerical objective, weighting rule, software, or published fit statistic is reported.
No row-wise Ne calibrant observations are published.
Deposited CCDC structure files require interactive access; the existing equivalent Pbnm/Pnma FA50 material card is therefore reused without fabricating atom coordinates.

parameter_provenance.determination_method: Measurements or their experimental reduction determine this EOS; source: publisher article Materials and methods and Figure 4 caption; official Supplementary Table S3.
parameter_provenance.equation: Article Figure 4 caption and EOS discussion: second-order Birch-Murnaghan pressure-volume equation, equivalent to K0'=4.
parameter_provenance.V0: Article Figure 4 caption: V0=171.2+/-0.2 angstrom^3 for the high-pressure Pnma Fe0.5Mg0.5Al0.5Si0.5O3 phase.
parameter_provenance.K0: Article Figure 4 caption: K0=221+/-3 GPa for the high-pressure Pnma Fe0.5Mg0.5Al0.5Si0.5O3 phase. A later general discussion prints 212(3) GPa, but the composition-specific figure caption, plotted curve, and independently reproduced Table S3 fit support 221(3) GPa.
parameter_provenance.fit_selection: Supplementary Table S3 Pnma observations at 10.8-60.0 GPa; two refinements within the 8+/-2 GPa transition interval are excluded.
parameter_provenance.uncertainties: Published parameter uncertainties are retained; confidence convention and covariance are not reported.

superseded_record_text.label: Koemets et al. (2023) single-crystal Pnma perovskite BM2
superseded_record_text.notes: Accepted LitCurate record litcurate_1a8c16a1075ca2d2. Pnma is an alternative setting of the material card's Pbnm space group 62. The low-pressure R3c and FeMg0.5Si0.5O3 P21/n candidates require distinct phase cards and were not added in this batch.
validity_notes: Bounds are the selected Pnma observation envelope, not a broader phase-stability field.
V0 is extrapolated because the Pnma perovskite is not retained at ambient pressure.
The 7.5 and 8.6 GPa measurements fall in the reported structural-transition interval and are outside this fit.
